reading.body:
Tecnodati S.R.L. is an unverified OpenStreetMap record, not a confirmed data center, and it carries no capacity figure at all.

The record is a single node tagged telecom=data_center near Parma, Italy, with a name that fits an Italian IT or data-services company. The research note is explicit that no operator website, press coverage, or business registration was confirmed, and that the search quota ran out before verification could happen. The only source listed is an OpenStreetMap tagging review.

For AI infrastructure, the useful signal is the absence of a number. The record reports zero megawatts, and zero here means unknown rather than empty, so it cannot be counted toward any estimate of regional compute capacity. A name containing "dati" is a naming pattern, not evidence of servers.

What this does not tell the reader is whether a facility exists at these coordinates, how large it is, or whether it serves AI workloads at all. It also does not establish that Italy's data-center inventory is small or large, because one unconfirmed node supports no conclusion about the whole.
